The University of Angers' Board of Governors will review and approve the details of how these measures will be applied, including the criteria, procedures and scope for exemptions, in early July 2026. Further information will be published in the coming weeks to support prospective students and the wider university community. # Admissions Admission procedures vary according to your nationality, the country where you obtained your baccalaureate (or secondary school diploma), your country of residence, and the course and year of study you wish to apply for. * ## You are a european student European students are students with a nationality from: + One of the [27 countries of the EU](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/key-facts-and-figures/structure_en) + A country included in the EEA (EU + Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein) + Switzerland + Monaco or Andorra ### Applying for the 1st year of a Bachelor's degree (L1), PluriPASS or BUT European students who want to join the French higher education system in **1st year of a Bachelor’s degree** (“Licence”) or a **Bachelor of Technology** (BUT) must apply on the **[“Parcoursup” platform](https://parcoursup.fr/).**The application process is mandatory to apply to most of the degrees offered by higher education institutions. For Europeans and students living abroad, please note that **L1 Psychology has a very limited capacity**, there will be no international recruitment, only applications from students living in Maine-et-Loire, Mayenne and Sarthe can be considered.
